description: T120 independent KKT/direct-solve reference comparison suite configuration. See tasks/T120-independent-kkt-reference.md and src/comppareto/kkt_compare.py.
notes: Thresholds are tiered by algorithm-family independence: the Cholesky private-response/Schur path and the exact-rational path solve the same linear system as production through a different LAPACK routine (or no floating point at all), so they are held to a near-machine-precision bar. The generalized-eigenvalue trust-region secular solve is the same secular equation as production viewed in a different basis, so it is held to a tight-but-not-machine-precision bar. The trust-constr black-box solves (trust-region subproblem and negotiation max-min problem) are a fully separate interior-point/SQP algorithm family with looser default solver tolerances, so they are held to a visibly looser bar. Actual achieved maxima across the full run are always recorded in runs/t1b-kkt-*/summary.json alongside these thresholds -- see that file for the true numbers, not just pass/fail.
